pm_exper_user_2553_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.question: What are some fun, easy ways to keep in touch with friends who live far away?
pm_exper_user_2553_maasv_v0446_pmv2_r1.all_options:
(a) You could set up a regular group video call with your friends to catch up and share what’s been happening. Sending quick photos or short videos from your day can help them feel included and keep the connection strong.
(b) Seeing as you’re into the footy, you could arrange to watch the same game with your mates while on a group call, so you can cheer (or groan) together in real time. Sending each other quick updates or score predictions during the week can keep the banter going.
(c) Since you've already got the smartphone handy, you could set up a regular group video call with your mates — maybe while you're having a cuppa in the shed. Sharing quick photos or short videos from around the farm can also give them a slice of your day, and a laugh when the sheep get up to mischief.
(d) If you enjoy cooking, you could swap recipes with your mates over a regular video call, each trying the other’s creations. You might even send each other short clips of you making the dish so they can pick up your tricks in the kitchen.
